title: Safe to Serve: Aligning Instruction-Tuned Models for Safety and Helpfulness
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety alignment (helpfulness and harmlessness) and uses datasets like I-CoNA (hate speech) and I-Controversial. While safety and harmlessness are ethical dimensions of AI development, the paper is a technical alignment study and does not evaluate religion or formal systems of morality/ethics beyond standard safety and toxicity benchmarks.
